theorems.name: Submission.rsod_blowUp_integral_tendsto_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (x : Amb n ℓ) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) A < ∞ → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).real (A ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Amb n ℓ) ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' A, f y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
